supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: moderate extension beyond the lateral eye corner

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle area exhibits higher pixel intensity (lighter) relative to the darker cheek and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick lower lip with a visible structural droop

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: minor irregularities and possible tissue loss along the superior helix

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: visible scarring and structural irregularity on the upper portion of the right ear pinna
other_distinctive_markers: prominent white/greyish terminal hairs located on the lower muzzle and chin
